intervention: For the first divergent non-EOS completion token in each of 20 explicit concern/clean pairs, replace its original example coefficient with the pooled mean over 40 positions. All other 2319 coefficients, data and optimizer parameters stay unchanged.
checkpoint_selection: Among saved epochs 4/8/12 maximize exact teacher-forced review pairs, then review macro per-example token accuracy, then earlier epoch. Keep previous selector; decision-token scores are diagnostics. Select before inspecting generation.
interpretation: The alternative clean token is a JSON prefix. Target-token margins are recorded separately from generated JSON verdicts and semantic review quality.

additional_diagnostic.purpose: Generate line IDs and reasons after supplying only the common concern-structure prefix; compare complete assembled JSON with natural outputs.
additional_diagnostic.source: Our diagnostic informed by Bachmann and Nagarajan2024 and Lin et al2025. It does not alter training or checkpoint selection.
